name: Google
short_desc: External: sign in to Google once; choose what your agent may use.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Contacts and YouTube for your Wizard agent, through gog. Sign in once per Google account (several accounts), then switch services on per account. Sign-ins stay encrypted on this box.

form_fields.label: External: Owner tailnet logins
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated Tailscale logins allowed to use the page inside the Wizard shell.

form_fields.label: External: Shared return page
form_fields.hint: Optional. Only for a box without its own https address.

form_fields.label: External: Gateway owner secret
form_fields.hint: Optional: for a gateway that injects X-Wizard-Owner-Token instead of Tailscale identity.

form_fields.label: External: MCP admin secret
form_fields.hint: Optional bearer for MCP from outside this box.

form_fields.label: External: Quick sign-in service
form_fields.hint: Optional. Leave empty for the default; set to 'off' to allow only your own Google client.
